Kids Party Photo Collection & Digital Invitation

The easiest way to invite guests, manage RSVPs and collect every party photo and video, privately.

From kids birthday parties and baby showers to religious celebrations, your child’s special moments deserve to be remembered in the highest quality possible.

Collect full resolution photos and videos from family and friends in a fully private, easy-to-use digital gallery you and your guests will love.

No more scattered group chats with low quality photos or worrying about posting pictures of your (or other children) on social media. 

How GUESTPIX Works For Kids Parties
Step 1. Create your event Step 2. Display your QR Code / share your link Step 3. Enjoy the memories

Digital kids party invitation, RSVPs and photo collection in one place

Parties should be fun, not a mess of group chats, lost RSVPs and scattered photos. 

That’s where GUESTPIX™ comes in – one private link for invitations, RSVPs and guest photos collected in one secure place. Easy for parents, safe for kids.

Planning your kids party just got a whole lot easier!

How it Works
Pricing
Capture their special birthday through the eyes of the people who love them most and save it for years to come.

With GUESTPIX, you'll enjoy...

safe sharing, always

Share your gallery with peace of mind. It’s completely private and can only be viewed by the people you share the link with.

full quality pics & vids

Guests can capture moments as they naturally happen and upload them straight to your gallery at any time.

grandma-proof

Everyone can join in! It’s so easy for guests to rsvp and/or share photos. No tech stress, even grandma can do it!

100% your memories

You and your guests retain full ownership of every memory. GUESTPIX™ simply keeps them safe for you to enjoy forever!

live slideshow

Watch as memories appear in real time. It’s a fun way to showcase your party for everyone & the kids to enjoy.

freeze the memories

We know the years feel like days so you’ll want to look back on the bank of memories you collected. Don’t miss it.

Loved & Used For...

MILESTONE BIRTHDAYS
KIDS BIRTHDAYS
QUINCEANERA
BAR MITZVAH
BABY SHOWER
NO GUEST REGISTRATION +

NO APP TO DOWNLOAD

With GUESTPIX™ there’s no need to ask guests to download a party photo sharing app or to register!
Simply share your unique GUESTPIX™ QR code or send your private link to guests. Everyone can instantly upload their favorite photos, videos and even guestbook messages.

Set up in 2 minutes - it's that easy!

FREE Bonus: Editable Kids Party QR Code Canva Templates

Enjoy our gorgeous range of kids party print templates! Add your GUESTPIX™ QR code to mini take home cards, or table cards as a reminder for guests to view and upload to the party gallery. Too easy! 

Party Design Themes

TAP THE COLOUR WHEEL TO EXPLORE OUR DESIGNS

Make your child’s party memories match their party theme. Choose from 20 beautiful gallery design themes.

Whether it’s a first birthday, a milestone moment or a fun backyard celebration, these playful designs let you personalize your gallery so it perfectly matches the party theme and style.

Reviews

“I enjoyed incorporating GUESTPIX in my son’s birthday. It holds such a special place for me because I was able to capture all wonderful moments I shared with my family and friends celebrating my son’s 1st birthday. I loved capturing the beautiful decorations and activities, and seeing everyone who came out to celebrate my boy’s special day.”

Pau (May 2025)

“Easy and safe! I am not a big fan of sharing photos of my kids online and with Guestpix I don’t have to! My guests loved uploading videos and photos through the QR code and what I love most is that it’s all in full resolution, no more blurry videos! I have 3 kids and this is an easy all in one solution (especially now with invitations and rsvps). I am even looking at using it for an end of term catch up with all the school parents.”

Kim (Dec 2025)

More About GUESTPIX™ Kids Parties

Every great celebration deserves lasting memories, and finding creative ways to capture them has never been easier. Whether you’re planning a kids birthday, baby shower, or graduation, incorporating a digital element into your event makes sharing and preserving special moments effortless. While traditional guestbooks are still used, many hosts are now looking for alternatives to guestbook websites that offer a more interactive and visual way to remember the occasion.

For expectant parents, a baby shower guest book is a wonderful keepsake, but instead of just collecting signatures, why not encourage guests to share photos and heartfelt messages digitally? A QR code linked to a shared album allows guests to upload pictures and leave notes, creating a modern and interactive experience. Similarly, a party photo booth is a fantastic way to capture fun, candid moments. With the right backdrop and props, guests can snap pictures and instantly share them, making the event even more memorable.

If you’re looking for an easy way to design invites, GUESTPIX™ offers access to 50+ editable Canva templates with every purchase. Using a party invitation template can save time while keeping your event stylish and organized. Whether you need a graduation party invitation template for a milestone celebration or a birthday invite that matches your party theme, the GUESTPIX™ suite of customizable templates makes it simple to create something unique and personal.

From digital guestbooks to QR-powered photo sharing and modern invitations, today’s party planning options make it easier than ever to bring people together and preserve memories. No matter the occasion, incorporating fun and interactive elements ensures your celebration is one to remember!
